findings.excerpt: title: "The Murphy cellular basis of H(S_3)"
findings.symptom: The title renders the ASCII underscore literally in “H(S_3)” instead of typesetting the group subscript.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the notation in math delimiters, e.g. “The Murphy cellular basis of $H(S_3)$.”

findings.excerpt: The statement and proof use notation such as i_1^{r_1}...i_s^{r_s}, c=tilde f_{i_s}^{r_s}...u_Lambda, and product_a [r_a]_{i_a}!, but this body text has no math delimiters.
findings.symptom: The complete Statement and proof display their mathematical notation as raw ASCII, including underscores, carets, and unrendered function/product notation; the local HTML has zero KaTeX nodes.
findings.suggested_repair: Typeset the mathematical expressions throughout the Statement, Facts, and Proof with the item math delimiters; preserve the stated formulas and surrounding prose.

findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** direct; build the induction algebra and restriction coalgebra, then the contracting homotopy for the Serre relation, then descend $\gamma$.
findings.symptom: The proof-technique banner is plain text and exposes the literal LaTeX delimiters and command (“$\GAMMA$” after CSS uppercase styling) in the screenshot.
findings.suggested_repair: Use plain text “gamma” in the technique banner or remove the math delimiters there; keep the rendered formulas in the Statement/Proof.

candidate_diagrams.claim: The definition specifies a weighted oriented 2-category with downward G_j and upward H_i strands, adjunction maps, and a rank-one decomposition/matrix inverse that depends on the input i-weight h.
candidate_diagrams.why_warranted: The text carries source and target weights, strand directions, degree shifts, and separate h≥0 and h<0 decompositions in dense prose. A small diagram can make the orientation and direct-summand maps easier to check.
candidate_diagrams.specific_content: Use outside weight μ and i-weight h; show the word objects P=G_iH_i and V=H_iG_i, units ημ,η′μ and counits εμ,ε′μ, native sideways mate T and inverse mate S. For h≥0 show ρ=(-T,(C_k)):P⊕D_h→V and σ=(S,(R_k)):V→P⊕D_h, with D_h=⊕_{k=0}^{h-1}1{d_i(1-h+2k)}, C_k=x^kημ and R_k=Σ_{a+j=h-1-k}A_{μ,j}ε′μx^a; label σρ=1 and ρσ=1 and the component relations in lines 125–126. If showing the h<0 branch, use its distinct source/target matrix and D_{-h} shifts from lines 127–139. Preserve chronology, weight labels, and grading shifts; do not imply the concrete flag bimodules satisfy this presentation without the separate local realization proof (line 140).
candidate_diagrams.confidence: possible, source-supported; optional, not a confirmed rendering error

candidate_diagrams.claim: The eight ambient labels have a stated rectification map, and ambient multipartition transpose reverses components while transposing shapes; on the standard-label subset, sign fixes 00, 01, 11 and swaps 0R with 0C.
candidate_diagrams.why_warranted: The example distinguishes the ambient eight-label permutation from maps on standard and reverse-standard subsets, and warns against treating off-standard labels as Hecke simple/projective labels. A labeled map diagram can make these domains and exceptions immediately visible.
candidate_diagrams.specific_content: Draw the eight nodes 00, 01, 10, 11, 0R, R0, 0C, C0. Mark Std={00,01,11,0R,0C} and Rev={00,10,11,R0,C0}; draw rectification arrows 10→01, R0→0R, C0→0C and ambient transpose pairs 01↔10, 0R↔C0, R0↔0C with 00 and 11 fixed. Mark the actual highest-constituent action from lines 80–83 separately: P01/D01 fixed, P0R/D0R exchanged with P0C/D0C; do not draw an action swapping P01 with nonexistent ambient P10 or D01 with D10.
candidate_diagrams.confidence: possible, source-supported; optional, not a confirmed rendering error

candidate_diagrams.claim: The divided-power classes satisfy the quantum Serre relation via a finite split-contractible complex of projectives C_r, whose alternating class gives the relation.
candidate_diagrams.why_warranted: The proof compresses a sequence of typed bimodule maps, grading shifts, an explicit homotopy, and the resulting alternating-sum identity into one paragraph. A schematic chain would expose endpoints, degree-zero maps, and where the homotopy identity is checked.
candidate_diagrams.specific_content: For fixed i≠j, d=−a_ij and D=d+1, draw the terms C_r=R E_r{s_r} supported at words i^r j i^{D-r}, r=0,…,D, arrows a_r:C_r→C_{r+1}, and reverse maps b_r. Label h_r=(−1)^r t^{-1}b_r, t=[u^d]Q_ij≠0, and the corner identity a_rh_r+h_{r−1}a_{r−1}=E_r (with absent endpoint terms zero). Then map the alternating sum to Σ_{a+b=D}(−1)^a[P_{i,a}][P_{j,1}][P_{i,b}]=0. Avoid suggesting this is a raw string-diagram relation before taking projective classes.
candidate_diagrams.confidence: possible, source-supported; optional, not a confirmed rendering error
